subject.title: Feature Request: Add Skill Priority Configuration

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class skill priority/ordering contract, and should it live in canonical skills.entries config, skill metadata, agent allowlists, or a broader smart-loading design instead?
rationale: The requested behavior changes public config/CLI shape and prompt ordering semantics, so source inspection can prove it is missing but cannot choose the permanent product contract.

options.title: Add canonical config priority
options.body: Add a priority/order field under skills.entries with schema, CLI, docs, and tests, while preserving existing eligibility filters and prompt limits.

options.title: Fold into smart skill loading
options.body: Defer this issue to a broader skill search/indexing design so priority is not added as a separate config surface.

options.title: Keep existing controls only
options.body: Close the feature request and direct users to per-agent skill allowlists plus truncation diagnostics instead of adding another ordering knob.

recommendation.title: Add canonical config priority
recommendation.body: Add a priority/order field under skills.entries with schema, CLI, docs, and tests, while preserving existing eligibility filters and prompt limits.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this owner to both skills CLI scoping and canonical skill config tests, which are the likely public surfaces for the decision.
